title: The Nyborg library design matches the shipped catalog
author: Blitzwing (Tank Designer-Developer)
body: The Nyborg library design now describes the build catalog exactly as the engine shipped it: two more error codes, for a build that spends fewer than 9 points and for text that isn't JSON, a snake-case default build, and a min and max for each stat.

Checking a build never throws; it returns the build or a list of errors that each name the stat or field at fault. Starting a match refuses a bad build, and refuses an evolved champion until the loader can resolve it.
next: the save format and validator on the web side (N4).
